name: Optical Control chooses a card type on enter
notes: Optical Control is a LUXEM (advanced element) PHANTASIA card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real LUXEM champion (Zander, Blinding Steel) to unlock element access, reused from insignia-of-the-corhazi-prep-counter. As a PHANTASIA card it materializes onto the field via the normal ALLY/ITEM-style flow, so its enterAbilities fire correctly with no extra opportunity-window PASS needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 3-reserve cost is paid, then a NUMBERCHOOSE decision picks the card type (answered with "2" for ALLY), tagging the source object with j4U5Tu76Lz-ALLY. The opponent-cost-increase and recollection-phase self-sacrifice-and-draw clauses are out of scope.

rulesClauses: As CARDNAME enters the field, choose a card type.
